about.description: XAGa is Assetiko Silver, a tokenized silver product on the XRP Ledger issued by Assetiko Commodities Ltd. under the Assetiko group. One XAGa is designed to reference one troy ounce of silver with reserves that Assetiko describes as one hundred percent physical silver at claimed coverage of approximately one hundred and two point three percent. Assetiko discloses issuer identity, custodian, vault operator, insurance carrier, and independent auditor only as "Restricted Records" available upon identity-verified request. No public proof of reserves attestation, no named auditor, and no financial regulator or licence are identified as of this review. The token trades against Valtorum USD (USDV) via an XRP Ledger automated market maker. The XAGa issuer wallet was activated on the XRP Ledger within the last week of this review with a small handful of trustline holders and a single automated market maker liquidity provider, and the row is flagged Suspicious pending publication of independent reserves verification.
